Teammates are awesome for security monitoring!

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Aravind Srinivas megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Kyle Polley (@kpolley); megjelent: 2026-11-26T04:34:52+00:00; link: https://x.com/kpolley/status/2125810493986124083; média: 1 kép]
1Password was compromised because a hacker got access to GitHub and created a malicious code change that was subsequently approved and pushed to production. 

If you are worried about this happening in your own repo, you can set up a security teammate to continuously monitor incoming PRs and alert when it finds any code that is intentionally malicious. 

I didn’t even have to prompt my new teammate to get started — it immediately understood the assignment from the name I gave it and got to work
